mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wuzixinxi WHERE wuzimingcheng = #{wuzimingcheng} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE wuzixinxi SET wuzishuliang = wuzishuliang + #{delta} WHERE wuzimingcheng = #{wuzimingcheng}
mapper.select: SELECT wuzifenlei, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, GROUP_CONCAT(wuzimingcheng) AS items, MIN(wuzishuliang) AS minStock FROM wuzixinxi WHERE wuzishuliang <= #{threshold} GROUP BY wuzifenlei
